text:
amanda: Heads-up — we did a quick design spike on adding filter guardrails to the console. Idea: show per-route 'quota preview' and suggested safe filters when someone saves a query that would blow the route's sampling or token budget.

kevin: short version: preview badge + suggested filters? love it. what's the source of truth for the quota numbers?

jess: routing policy & quota service is the source (internal /v1/route-metrics). we can pull current committed throughput + sample rate. concern: latency of calling that from the UI on every save.

marco: agree on latency. we should cache the quota snapshot per route for ~5m in the console backend. also we already have a small aggregator we can reuse.

amanda: UX thought: when user hits Save, we run the check and show a lightweight modal: "This saved query would increase route cost by ~12% — apply suggested filters? [Apply] [Keep as-is]". no blocking by default. :warning:

kevin: sounds good. how do we compute "suggested filters"? heuristics? ML?

jess: start with heuristics: add model pin to a cheaper family, increase sampling, or add prefix trimming for long inputs. e.g. transform: sampling=0.2, model=compact-v2. those three suggestions are easy to generate.

zach: can we include a small token burn estimate and break it down by model + sample? like: tokens/day, cost/day (est). customers ask for that a lot.

amanda: yes, show a 2-line breakdown. keep it approximate. goal is to nudge users to safer defaults.

marco: implementation notes: console UI will call POST /console/v1/preview-saved-query with payload {route_id, query, model_hint, sample_hint}. backend will call routing/quota service and return {delta_tokens, suggested_actions}. caching on route snapshot to avoid spikes.

kevin: API shape fine but can we reuse existing preview endpoint for cost-preview? we already have /console/v1/cost-preview that accepts routes and prompts. mixing might be confusing. propose /console/v1/saved-query-guardrail-preview.

jess: internal API debate: I'd rather extend cost-preview with a query_mode flag to avoid adding endpoints. downside: more branching in the endpoint.

marco: prefer a dedicated endpoint for now — simpler to rollout and to gate behind feature flags for early access.

amanda: decision: dedicated endpoint under a feature flag. marco to implement backend cache + callouts, jess to adapt routing service client. kevin to wire UI modal and badge.

sre-bot: incident note: last rollouts of cost-preview caused a spike in API calls on 1768800000, recommend rate-limit + retry.

marco: noted. will add circuit-breaker + exponential backoff in backend call to routing/quota service.

kevin: small UX question: should suggested filters be auto-applied if user selects one, or should it prefill the save dialog only?

jess: prefill only. auto-apply is surprising and could break reproducibility. show a clear audit event if they accept.

amanda: telemetry: emit event savedquery.guardrail.preview_shown, preview_accepted, suggestion_chosen (with suggestion type). include sampling_rate/model_id as attributes but hash route_id for privacy.

zach: sampling for telemetry — let's sample 5% of previews with full context (query text) for debugging; rest send summary only. add flag telemetry.full_preview_sampling_rate.

amanda: APAC/regulatory note: saved queries can contain PII. default to redacting full query in telemetry unless customer has opted in. add checkbox in enterprise console settings.

kevin: mockups incoming shortly. I'll include the badge ("Quota preview") in the saved query list and the modal.

marco: who owns rollout? we should do canary to 10% of orgs then 50, then-wide. link this to dedicated capacity customers differently (they have contract constraints).

amanda: rollout plan: feature-flagged canary (10% internal orgs + dev tenants) -> 50% -> GA. special handling: for Dedicated customers with strict SLAs, default preview queries run on a detached read-only snapshot not live quotas.

jess: follow-up tech tasks:
- add endpoint /console/v1/saved-query-guardrail-preview (marco)
- cache route snapshot 5m (marco)
- integrate with routing/quota service (jess)
- telemetry hooks + sampling config (zach)
- UI badge + modal + audit event (kevin)

amanda: timeline: prototype backend + UI and telemetry in 2 weeks for internal canary.

kevin: ack. I might add a small new UI control: "Always prefer cheaper model suggestions" per-team setting. will add in mock.

zach: signing off for now, will add telemetry config PR.

amanda: thanks everyone. I'll post the mock and the feature flag name in a follow-up: ff_console_savedquery_guardrails. :sparkles:
